frigg — 21Stark IT-ops headless CLI

Usage: frigg <command> [args]
       frigg help <group>

usage: frigg ga4 <verb> [flags]

Commands:
  ga4          read-only Google Analytics 4  (45)
  gitlab       GitLab reads and gated writes  (55)
  cockpit      launch the full-screen TUI  (TUI)
  version      print the version  (creds-free)
  group-delete  Dissolve a group AND DELETE its items  (DELETE)
  sql          read-only SQL escape hatch  (may return PII)
  assign-role  grant a custom role  (gate: WRITES)
  add-member   add someone to a group  (required)
  write-out    write the raw result to FILE  (0600)
  list-empty   a catalog with nothing in it  (0)
  offboarding-audit  cross-vendor read-only audit
  get-account  Get one GA4 account by id (--account accounts/<id>)
  run-report   run a Data API report (the request carries the property, so a
               long trailing note like this one is content, not a tag)

Options:
  --json       emit the typed projection
  -o FILE      write the raw result to FILE (0600)
  --confirm    execute the write

Notes:
  • Write posture: every write is dry-run by default; pass --confirm.
  › Reads are free; a kill switch is honored for reads too.
  ! Secret-bearing output REQUIRES -o and never touches stdout.

Examples:
  frigg ga4 list-accounts --json
  frigg invoke notion.get_page --arg page_id="abc" -o out.json
  frigg search 'deactivate user'

Exit: 0 ok, 2 usage, 3 config/creds, 15 write_disabled.
